updates.rationale: The exact fixed-receiver certificate and reusable weak-duality construction make this converse program more promising, while receiver-pair optimality and a matching achievable rate remain open.

The submission supplies the exact six-row reduction, continuous weak-duality certificate, and executable verifier for the selected receiver pair; only limited replay and integration work remains in this local package.

The manifested candidate, exact dual reduction, and certificate architecture substantially clarify the next research steps, though a rigorous optimization over receiver pairs and coordination with achievability still require planning.

The fixed-pair witness and reusable certificate machinery narrow and instrument the search, but they do not establish global receiver or dual optimality, so substantial search and proof development remain.
